  1. INTRODUCTION
FitBuddy is a Generative AI based fitness plan generator designed to create simple and personalized fitness guidance from user-provided information. The system uses Gemini models to understand a user's goals, preferences, available time and fitness level, and then produces a structured plan. The main purpose of FitBuddy is to demonstrate how Generative AI can be used to build a practical application. Instead of presenting the same routine to every user, the application accepts inputs and generates an appropriate plan in natural language. Project Objectives Create an easy-to-use AI powered fitness planning application. Generate personalized workout and lifestyle suggestions from user inputs.
